edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC4 Access without the Case record right (exception X2)
    Given a role without the Case record right
    When the role requests the handling of the X2 deviation
    Then the request is refused with 403 before any read or write, nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC5 Deviation code not handled (exception X4)
    Given a deviation whose code is not one of X1 to X7
    When the step runs
    Then nothing is written, the reason is reported, the deviation stays where it is and the user sees MSG-GEN-001

  Scenario: AC6 Stale ACE data product (exception X5)
    Given an ACE data product is stale after a late or failed batch
    When the step runs
    Then the step holds, nothing is written, the date it waits on is shown, the user sees MSG-P1-001 and the step resumes on the next fresh answer

  Scenario: AC7 Repeated request (exception X7)
    Given a repeated request for the same deviation, outcome and package version
    When the request is repeated
    Then one row, one record, one event and one answer exist for the deviation and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC8 Boundary (exception X8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a recovery_case row, a v_ace_* view or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released
